entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: The cake here's fairly popular. I've been[n]wanting to try it myself.
Got a sweet tooth, huh?
Come here often?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, I don't hate sweets, but I'm not[n]exactly partial to them...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: No, I only learned about it recently.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Fads tend to be fairly similar, so I'm more[n]curious about its popularity than its taste.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, why don't we give it a try?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Mm. It was delicious after all...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I actually enjoyed that more than I[n]thought I would.

entries.speaker: Fad-Following Woman
entries.en: Hey, look! Isn't that him?

entries.speaker: Forgetful Woman
entries.en: Ohh, you mean the guy who's on TV[n]these days... Who was he again?

entries.speaker: Fad-Following Woman
entries.en: Wasn't his name Akechi-kun? You know,[n]the next-generation Detective Prince...?

entries.speaker: Fad-Following Woman
entries.en: Should we ask him for an autograph?[n]Might be something worth bragging[n]about...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Uh-oh. Looks like I've been spotted.
Should've figured.[clr 27]
Your life must be so hard.
I can shoo them away...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: She's just here for the cake, I'm guessing.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I'm sure she doesn't mean any harm,[n]but I don't want to cause any trouble[n]for the store...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Oh, I'm used to it, but I don't want[n]to cause trouble for the store.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Haha, I don't think that'd work out well.[n]I have a public image to think about.

entries.speaker: Male Passerby
entries.en: Huh? Is someone important here?

entries.speaker: Gossipy Woman
entries.en: Who is it? *gasp* Is it a celebrity!?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Looks like I'm out of time. I wish I[n]could've relaxed a little longer, though.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: We should go.
You've done nothing wrong.
Why the rush?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Sorry, but I think it'd be best to leave.[n]I'm only going to cause problems if[n]I stay.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: A shame I don't have glasses like you.[n]Maybe I would have been able to get[n]out of this situation.
How about we find out?
Come here a sec.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Huh? Hey, what are you—!?

entries.speaker: Fad-Following Woman
entries.en: Oh, he's back. This time, I'll get his[n]autograph for...

entries.speaker: Forgetful Woman
entries.en: Hey, is that boy really Akechi-kun?

entries.speaker: Fad-Following Woman
entries.en: You know... Now that I see him up[n]close, I'm not sure...

entries.speaker: Forgetful Woman
entries.en: Maybe you were seeing things?

entries.speaker: Forgetful Woman
entries.en: I don't remember the show too well,[n]but I'm pretty sure he didn't look like[n]that.

entries.speaker: Fad-Following Woman
entries.en: Aww! If he was the real thing, I could've[n]bragged about meeting him.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: ...I can't believe you actually did that.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I suppose I'd better learn to watch[n]what I say around you.
You looked great.
It was a necessary evil.
I should've taken a picture...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Is that so? Well, who else could make a[n]peasant of the Detective Prince?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, you saved me.

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I daresay such crude means would[n]never have occurred to me...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Haha... Are you familiar with the legal[n]right of portrait? Or privacy, perhaps?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Still... there's no knowing how things[n]may go unless you give it a try, hm?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: I think I've learned a valuable lesson.[n]Thank you.
I can sense Akechi's[n]gratitude towards me...

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Looks like our coffee's gone cold. Why[n]don't we order new ones?

entries.speaker: Akechi
entries.en: Well, see you next time.
